text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — PRODUCTION — elevated 5xx and TLS handshake failures observed on prod-gateway. Affected: ~12% global. Paging on-call SREs: @sre-luis @alex @eng-ryan. Incident link: <https://incidents.redwood/2612345678>

sre-luis: I'm on it. I'm seeing a big spike in TLS handshake_failure + SSL verify errors from upstream mTLS connections. Digging into gateway logs now.

alex: quick log sample: 
```
[2026-03-15T08:59:01Z] gateway[pid=3] ERROR TLS handshake failed: error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate expired (verify return code: 10)
```

viv: Is that our server cert or the client cert used to authenticate to partners?

alex: looks to be our client cert used for mTLS to partner upstreams (acme-corp, partner-x). The leaf expired at 2026-03-15T08:58:00Z.

eng-ryan: Two mitigation paths: 1) route traffic to prod-gw-fallback pool where the previous cert is still valid, or 2) emergency rotate cert via rotator service. What's rotator health?

sre-luis: rotator is returning 500s on decrypt. Rotator logs: 
```
rotator ERROR KMS decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt
```

pm-jordan: Customer impact: customers seeing 502s/timeouts; status page needs an update. I'm drafting an initial notification.

alex: If rotator is out, we can manual push cert into k8s secret and restart gateway pods. Quick steps: 
```
# create k8s secret with new cert/key (assumes /tmp/new-cert.pem present)
kubectl -n prod create secret generic prod-gateway-mtls --from-file=cert.pem=/tmp/new-cert.pem --from-file=privkey.pem=/tmp/new-key.pem --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl rollout restart deploy/prod-gateway -n ingress
```

eng-ryan: I'll fetch the new cert from Vault and attempt manual push. If we can't rotate, I'll shift traffic to fallback first to reduce customer impact.

sre-luis: Good. Also, prepare to update the status page and let CS know which tenants are affected.

eng-ryan: Doing a traffic shift to fallback now (dry-run then commit): 
```
httpctl traffic-shift --from prod-gateway --to prod-gw-fallback --percent 100 --dry-run
httpctl traffic-shift --from prod-gateway --to prod-gw-fallback --percent 100
```

alex: Confirming — fallback is serving requests successfully. Error rate dropped from ~12% -> ~0.9% after shift.

inc-bot: update — mitigation in progress: traffic shifted to fallback pool, monitoring for recovery.

viv: Please notify customer-success to open support cases for impacted customers and include the temporary mitigation steps in the ticket.

pm-jordan: Status update posted to status.redwood: "Service degraded — TLS handshake failures causing 5xx. Mitigation in progress."

eng-ryan: Manual secret push started. rotator still failing; KMS decrypt permission appears removed for the rotator principal. I'm uploading cert via kubectl now.

sre-luis: If manual push works, restart will pick up new certs. Also creating an infra ticket for the KMS policy rollback.

eng-ryan: Manual deploy complete. Rollout restarted. Current metrics: 
- TLS handshake failure rate: 0.7%
- 5xx rate: 0.6%
- P95 latency: stable

alex: Verified upstream mTLS health with a quick curl: 
```
$ curl -v https://upstream.acme/health
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* Peer certificate verified successfully
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

sre-luis: Good work. I'm setting pager to monitoring-only for 45 minutes. If no regression, we'll close the incident. Root cause looks like the cert rotation pipeline (rotator -> KMS) failed after a KMS policy change removed decrypt rights from the rotator role. Postmortem assigned to eng-infra.

pm-jordan: Customer communication sent and status page updated. Follow-ups: runbook updates to include manual cert push + traffic-shift steps and explicit rotator KMS check.

eng-ryan: Filing infra ticket ENG-INFRA-322 for KMS policy fix and RUNBOOK-77 for runbook improvements. I'll schedule a short postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

inc-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED — degraded service restored. Incident owner: sre-luis. Follow-ups: ENG-INFRA-322 (KMS policy), RUNBOOK-77 (manual cert rotation + fallback). Monitoring continues.
